ownership_summary.warning: Unobserved means not written by these renderer/state executions; it does not prove the field is globally unused or safe for Filter 2.

conclusion: The sweep maps renderer-owned outbound halfwords across every public machine and forced state. Any observed-owned field is rejected as universal Filter 2 transport. Unobserved fields require a whole-callback writer and consumer test before they can be considered candidates.
next_target: Trace all non-renderer writers and packet consumers for the unobserved fields, then test canary publication only in fields with no demonstrated stock owner.
safety: Stock firmware execution and synthetic renderer-state selection only; no firmware was modified.
